_docs.url: Absolute https URLs point at games hosted on their own origins (each game repo's GitHub Pages). Relative URLs ('the-herd/') resolve against this console's own address, for cartridges served locally during development. Any page built with @bosco98/primal-sdk works — plug and play.
_docs.origin: Derived from `url`, never configured: the console only completes a handshake with the origin it launched.
_docs.manifest: What the game NEEDS (channels, exercises, minutes) lives in the game's own /primal.manifest.json, fetched at launch. This file only says which games exist and where.
_docs.note: An HTTPS console can only embed HTTPS games (mixed content).
